name: Cleveland
takeaway: Cleveland's aggregation is SOPEC, supplied by AEP Energy, at 10.457¢/kWh fixed from August 2026 through July 2027. Eligible Illuminating Company residential and small-business accounts are enrolled. No fee to leave. Accounts over 700,000 kWh a year, national chains, and Cleveland Public Power meters are outside the program. The prior term was 9.236¢ from August 2025 through July 2026.
hook: Cleveland Illuminating Company small accounts on the city program are AEP Energy at 10.457¢ through July 2027, no exit fee. Keep Cleveland Public Power and large mercantile meters out of the quote.
notes: City of Cleveland aggregation is administered by SOPEC and supplied by AEP Energy at 10.457¢/kWh fixed, August 2026 through July 2027, for eligible Illuminating Company residential and small-business accounts. No fee to leave. The prior term was 9.236¢ from August 2025 through July 2026. Accounts over 700,000 kWh a year, national chains, PIPP, and the PUCO do-not-aggregate list are outside the program. Cleveland Public Power meters are a separate municipal system and are not on this aggregation.

name: Lakewood
takeaway: Lakewood defaults to NOPEC Green Community Choice at 10.599¢/kWh, renewable credits for 100% of usage, adder not above 0.20¢ over the 10.399¢ standard. The posted window is the September 2026 through June 2027 meter reads. No early termination fee. An account can move to the standard price by calling NOPEC. The prior green price was not in the sources checked on October 21, 2026.
hook: Lakewood small accounts default to NOPEC green at 10.599¢ through the June 2027 meter read, no exit fee. The 10.399¢ standard is available if they switch products.
notes: Lakewood is a NOPEC member. Green Community Choice is the default at 10.599¢/kWh for the September 2026 through June 2027 meter reads. The Illuminating Company delivers the power. Enrollment is automatic for eligible accounts.

name: Parma

Eligible residential and small-business accounts are enrolled unless they opted out or chose a fixed term (12-month 10.299¢, 24-month 10.599¢). Larger mercantile accounts are outside the aggregation.
